About PancakeSwap

PancakeSwap is the largest decentralized exchange on BNB Chain and also runs on several other networks. CAKE is used for liquidity incentives, governance and fee burns.

Where this CAKE price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (CAKE-USD), Binance (CAKE/USDT) and Kraken (CAKE/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 345,649,000 CAKE (supply last updated October 30, 2026). Prices on different exchanges can differ slightly; the table above shows each one and the spread between them.
